info.title: Bidora administrator invitation onboarding
info.description: Password setup and email-MFA entry point for Owner-issued administrator invitations.

x-approval.evidence: Administrator invitation links must lead to password setup, email verification/MFA and the Platform Admin Portal.

post.summary: Inspect an emailed invitation without accepting it
post.description: Approved Origin and trusted-network/identity attempt budgets are required. The one-time invitation capability is sent only in a bounded JSON body, never a query. Preview never consumes the invitation. Setup pins mailbox, names and role to the active unexpired record, creates credentials and consumes the invitation atomically with audit evidence; it never resets or converts an existing identity. Explicit submission of the emailed capability proves the mailbox. No authenticated session or MFA assurance is granted until the ordinary email-OTP sign-in completes. Tenant ties, cancellation, expiry, token rotation and single use remain enforced.

200.description: Validated invitation preview without token or credentials

400.description: Invalid, denied, throttled or unavailable request

403.description: Invalid, denied, throttled or unavailable request

409.description: Existing identity must sign in; password never overwritten
